title: Account for Bonds Issued at Face Value

items.concept: Initial recognition of bonds issued at face value; subsequent measurement schedule (constant carrying value; interest expense = cash interest); settlement at maturity
Number-variant twin — bonds issued at face with annual interest; subsequent measurement schedule; interest JE; maturity settlement
Period-end adjusting JE for face-value bonds when interest dates do not fall on year-end; subsequent cash settlement of Interest Payable; current-maturity reclassification; maturity settlement
Classification / presentation — issuance at face does not reduce stockholders’ equity; liability equals face
Subsequent measurement — for bonds at face, interest expense equals cash interest each period; carrying amount stays at face
